name: managed-preview-server
goal: One managed Harness preview is reused across starts; desktop launches share one backend.

evidence: Feature spec defines shared ownership, identity refusal, recovery, strict ports and desktop lifecycle.
Existing transport tests never repeated listen; preview tests owned isolated servers but never launched the dev command twice. Added reusable lifecycle cases.
Committed 4ecdbc49; recorded 5204e27a: duplicate previews kept running, occupied Vite port silently moved, and repeated transport listens returned different ports.
Both dev entrypoints share one OS-bound owner and strict Vite ports; Electron locks before readiness and transport listen reuses its promise.
